title: Begin under the Name before anything else
summary: The opening places the heart under the One, Truth, and the Guru's grace. Begin there before the tired self starts inventing another way to survive.
takeaway: Begin under the Name before exhaustion starts giving orders.
lifeApplication: Before the day becomes a negotiation with your limits, pause at Ik Oankar and let the first breath belong to the One, not to panic.

source.shortMeaning: The opening places the heart under the One, Truth, and the Guru's grace.
source.lifeApplication: When weariness wants to set the terms, begin again under the Name before reaching for relief.
